1. Run ChatGPT ads from Ad Manager. OpenAI now sits next to Meta, Google and LinkedIn. You need a connected OpenAI Ads account.
2. Share Meeting Room recordings by link, with passcodes, expiry dates and download controls.

5. Workflow execution logs now keep 60 days instead of 30, with a CSV export for agency admins and users.

Every Friday I sort through the HighLevel changelog so you don't have to. Nine updates went out this week. These five matter most for business owners:

4. Clients can book and cancel rentals in the new Client Portal, on accounts with Rentals turned on.
